protocol.universe: All archived Binance UM USDT perpetual symbol folders including inactive/delisted symbols, minus frozen non-crypto/stable exclusions in universe_classification.json. SPX6900 is included. Verified equities, ETFs, commodities and indices are excluded; five suspected non-crypto symbols excluded explicitly. No performance ranking/top-N selection. Historical metadata is not fully verified.
protocol.age_proxy: At least 30 days since first available warmup/data bar; conservative, not a verified exchange listing date
protocol.live_policy: No production code, thresholds, notifications, orders, deployment or live REST changes
protocol.entry: Existing core entry rule: next minute opening after decision plus configured 2 seconds. Fixed 60-second scan latency is an assumption, not a reconstruction of Telegram delivery.
protocol.execution: Existing sizing/exit rules, 72-hour observation censoring, stop first inside ambiguous 1m bar, gap stop at opening price; exchange tick/lot/depth are historical approximations
protocol.cost_stress: 1.5x fee, assumed spread and slippage on the exact same base-admitted quantity, entry/exit event and baseline risk denominator; funding unchanged; no rejection or re-selection under stress
protocol.publication_warning: OI/funding archive publication timestamps are unknown. Five-minute lag is a modelling assumption. No claim of exact historical real-time availability.

controls.random_direction: One deterministic hash-selected direction per original strategy event, same signal time and initial stop distance. Group comparison by original candidate direction; do not filter control direction again.
controls.random_timing: One deterministic uniformly ranked eligible time on the same symbol, UTC decision day and 4h trend direction, excluding the original time; same volume, age, geometry and trigger-range eligibility, without EMA reclaim. Choose before seeing outcomes; share repeated control events explicitly.
controls.missing_policy: Keep missing controls explicit. Primary comparison uses paired common UTC entry days with resolved outcomes and the relevant feature available in each arm. Also report exact matched-event comparisons and unmatched/native coverage. No renormalized zero returns for missing data.

protocol.primary_unit: Equal-weight UTC entry-day mean net R, not trade-weighted mean
descriptive_modes: all individually simulated setups (overlapping and dependent)
chronological core risk/capacity portfolio approximation per arm

pass_requirements.top3_rule: symbols with greatest total base net R within that hypothesis/side
pass_requirements.bootstrap: Fixed-seed paired calendar-week block resamples; preserve the complete calendar grid and missing/empty days; each supported day receives equal weight
pass_requirements.lower_bound: One-sided Bonferroni alpha=0.05/24 improvement bound must be above zero for all three comparisons at 1.5x cost
pass_requirements.unknown_outcomes: Report separately and pessimistically as -1R sensitivity, never count cancellations as losses; -1R is only sensitivity and is not a guaranteed worst case
pass_requirements.promotion: None automatic; even a passing result is a research candidate because holdout exposure, archived publication times and execution depth are unverified

protocol.regimes: Closed BTC 4h EMA20/EMA50 plus 3-bar EMA20 slope, same rule as frozen core; UP/DOWN/SIDEWAYS observational reporting only
protocol.known_previous_test: August 2026 exploration is excluded from this signal window. Old 120-bar -0.132141 result is retained and never pooled with this study.
changes_frozen_before_outcomes: four individual hypotheses and fixed thresholds
Research-only instrument taxonomy correction from official launch announcements; live universe unchanged

interventions.finding: Initial coverage audit: all funding ranks unknown because raw settlement timestamps vary by milliseconds. Observed 39875 raw records had 0–26ms offset. No aggregate returns inspected or thresholds tuned.
interventions.correction: Exclude raw timestamps after cutoff first; normalize funding-feature slots only when offset is <=1000ms and declared cadence agrees. Preserve raw timestamps for execution costs. Discard and retain separate v1 outcomes; rerun all symbols in new directory.

run_status.completion_note: Processing completion only; parsed-data/feature coverage remains separate in report.json.
